title: The 5 Best Carry-On Only Luggage
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for carry-on only luggage, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at carry-on only luggage using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Monos Carry-On Pro 22-Inch Hardside Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 22-inch polycarbonate hardshell, 36L capacity, Padded front compartment fits a 16-inch laptop, 360-degree spinner wheels.
strengths: Front laptop compartment is the most convenient at-security access of any bag in this list
36L capacity is genuinely usable for 4 to 7-day trips with compression cubes
Highest owner rating in this category at 4.8 out of 5
limitations: 22-inch size is on the larger edge of some tighter international carry-on sizers
No expansion panel, capacity is fixed
features: Padded front compartment fits a 16-inch laptop

products.name: Briggs & Riley Baseline 22-Inch Carry-On Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: 22-inch expandable softside carry-on, One-touch compression packing system, Internal garment system.
strengths: Compression system packs meaningfully more into the same 22-inch footprint
Internal garment system keeps a jacket or dress flatter than folding into cubes
Unconditional lifetime guarantee, the strongest warranty of any carry-on in this category
limitations: Softside shell compresses under overhead bin pressure, which some travelers see as a downside for fragile items

products.name: Samsonite Freeform Hardside Carry-On Spinner
products.blurb: Key specs: Expandable polypropylene hardshell, Dual 360-degree spinner wheels, TSA-approved combination lock.
strengths: Lightweight shell leaves more of the carry-on weight allowance for actual belongings
Hardshell resists crush damage in a packed overhead bin
limitations: Shows scratches and scuffs more visibly than fabric-shell competitors
Wheel housings wear faster under frequent use than the premium double-swivel designs

products.name: Amazon Basics 21" Hardside Expandable Spinner Carry-On
limitations: ABS shell scuffs more than polycarbonate
No built-in TSA lock on this version

products.name: Samsonite Omni 2 Hardside Expandable Carry-On Spinner
limitations: Expanded size may exceed carry-on limits

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
